description: MEAFS is a fitting tool software for spectra abundance analysis. It aims to provide a medium to high precision analysis for each individual absorption line in a given spectrum in a short runtime. The software can also fit wavelength shift, continuum and convolution of a spectrum.
keywords: spectral synthesis, chemical abundances, stellar atmospheres
title: Multiple Element Abundance Fitting Software, MEAFS
